name: Harvey Mudd College Summer Session (high school students welcome)
what_you_do: Take college courses with college students, in person or online. Subjects are computer science, engineering, math and arts. There are also classes in humanities and social science.
who_can_apply: The page says ambitious high school students, including rising juniors, may enroll. No age range or grade rule is listed.
pay_detail: Tuition is $4,250 per 3-credit course and $5,000 per 4-credit course (2026 prices). Financial aid on the page is only for Harvey Mudd students.
duration: 2026 Session I began May 26 and Session II began June 15
deadline_text: For summer 2026, registration began March 2 and the application with transcript was due May 7. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply page of the Summer Session site. You send a registration application with a transcript and pay fees before the course starts.
notes: Costs money and the courses are college level. Check the site in winter for 2027 dates and prices.
